keystones: Herd Migration;Sphinx of Clear Skies;Leyline Binding
core_cards: Territorial Maro;Drag to the Bottom;Briar Hydra;A-Briar Hydra;Nishoba Brawler;The Weatherseed Treaty;Slimefoot's Survey;Thran Portal;A-Thran Portal;Timeless Lotus;Llanowar Greenwidow;A-Llanowar Greenwidow;Radha's Firebrand;A-Radha's Firebrand;Pixie Illusionist
rationale: Payoffs at every rarity scale with basic land types while ten typed taplands, Thran Portal and Timeless Lotus provide the fixing.
pitch: Count your basic land types, then cash them in. Ten typed duals and Thran Portal fill out all five, turning Leyline Binding into a one-mana answer and Herd Migration into an entire board. For players who love ramping into powerful, splashy value.
pitch_es: Cuenta tus tipos de tierra básica y luego cóbralos. Diez duales con tipo y Thran Portal completan los cinco, convirtiendo Leyline Binding en una respuesta de un maná y Herd Migration en un tablero entero. Para quienes adoran acelerar hacia valor potente y llamativo.
rationale_es: Las recompensas escalan con los tipos de tierra básica en todas las rarezas, mientras diez tierras giradas con tipo, Thran Portal y Timeless Lotus aportan el fijado.

core_cards: Archangel of Wrath;Temporal Firestorm;Silver Scrutiny;Silverback Elder;Threats Undetected;The World Spell;Elvish Hydromancer;Shalai's Acolyte;Volshe Tideturner;Deathbloom Gardener;Salvaged Manaworker;Meteorite
rationale: 50 kicker/X cards reward extra mana; any-color ramp and Volshe Tideturner's kicked-spell mana fund the payoffs.
pitch: Start small, finish enormous. Kicker and X-cost spells like Shivan Devastator scale with every land you untap, and Volshe Tideturner helps pay for all of it. For players who like a card that is a turn-two play and a turn-eight finisher.
pitch_es: Empieza pequeño, termina enorme. El kicker y los hechizos con X como Shivan Devastator escalan con cada tierra que desgiras, y Volshe Tideturner ayuda a pagarlo todo. Para quienes gustan de una carta que es jugada de turno dos y finalizadora de turno ocho.
rationale_es: 50 cartas con kicker o X recompensan el maná extra; la aceleración de cualquier color y el maná para hechizos kickeados de Volshe Tideturner financian las recompensas.

core_cards: Elas il-Kor, Sadistic Pilgrim;Garna, Bloodfist of Keld;Liliana of the Veil;Bone Splinters;Cult Conscript;Phyrexian Vivisector;Aron, Benalia's Ruin;Ragefire Hellkite;Weatherlight Compleated;Tyrannical Pitlord;Defiler of Flesh;Squee, Dubious Monarch;Shadow-Rite Priest;Quirion Beastcaller
rationale: Death payoffs, sacrifice outlets and recursive fodder all have real depth; Tyrannical Pitlord and Defiler of Flesh join on oracle text.
pitch: Dying creatures are the point here, not the cost. Braids, Arisen Nightmare and Nemata, Primeval Warden pay you for every sacrifice while cheap recursive bodies keep the engine fed. For players who enjoy trading, draining and outlasting the opponent.
pitch_es: Aquí las criaturas que mueren son el objetivo, no el coste. Braids, Arisen Nightmare y Nemata, Primeval Warden te pagan por cada sacrificio mientras los cuerpos recursivos baratos mantienen alimentado el motor. Para quienes disfrutan intercambiando, drenando y sobreviviendo al rival.
rationale_es: Las recompensas por muerte, los medios de sacrificio y el forraje recursivo tienen todos profundidad real; Tyrannical Pitlord y Defiler of Flesh se suman por su texto de oracle.

keystones: Valiant Veteran;King Darien XLVIII;Queen Allenal of Ruadach
core_cards: Defiler of Faith;Resolute Reinforcements;Captain's Call;Argivian Cavalier;Baird, Argivian Recruiter;Argivian Phalanx;Heroic Charge;Guardian of New Benalia;Serra Redeemer;Chaotic Transformation;Keldon Strike Team;Tura Kennerüd, Skyknight
rationale: Soldier-token makers in five colors feed lords and width payoffs; enlist creatures want the same spare bodies.
pitch: A wide board, and then two lords to make it lethal. Valiant Veteran and King Darien XLVIII sit on top of token-makers in every colour and turn a modest army into an explosive attack. For players who like flooding the board and swinging as a team.
pitch_es: Un tablero ancho, y luego dos señores para volverlo letal. Valiant Veteran y King Darien XLVIII se sientan encima de creadores de fichas de todos los colores y convierten un ejército modesto en un ataque explosivo. Para quienes gustan de inundar el tablero y atacar en equipo.
rationale_es: Los creadores de fichas de Soldado en cinco colores alimentan a los señores y a las recompensas por anchura; las criaturas con enlist quieren esos mismos cuerpos sobrantes.

core_cards: Electrostatic Infantry;Ghitu Amplifier;Keldon Flamesage;Djinn of the Fountain;Raff, Weatherlight Stalwart;Thrill of Possibility;Twinferno;Najal, the Storm Runner;Founding the Third Path;Micromancer;Haughty Djinn;Cosmic Epiphany
rationale: Five separate instant/sorcery cast triggers plus engine rares; cheap kicker instants double as spell count.
pitch: Cheap spells cast in the right order, until the team is suddenly lethal. Balmor, Battlemage Captain and a squad of Wizards grow and burn as you chain instants and sorceries. For players who love a hyperactive, spell-slinging turn.
pitch_es: Hechizos baratos lanzados en el orden correcto, hasta que el equipo es letal de golpe. Balmor, Battlemage Captain y un escuadrón de Magos crecen y queman mientras encadenas instantáneos y conjuros. Para quienes adoran un turno hiperactivo lanzando hechizos.
rationale_es: Cinco disparos distintos por lanzar instantáneos o conjuros más raras que son motores; los instantáneos baratos con kicker hacen además de cuenta de hechizos.

core_cards: Tolarian Terror;Cosmic Epiphany;Writhing Necromass;Monstrous War-Leech;Eerie Soultender;Vohar, Vodalian Desecrator;Tribute to Urborg;Rona, Sheoldred's Faithful;Coral Colony;Shadow Prophecy
rationale: Payoffs count instants/sorceries or creatures in the graveyard while genuine mill enablers fill it.
pitch: Your graveyard is a discount, not a dumping ground. Tolarian Terror and Haughty Djinn get cheaper and bigger with every spell that lands in it, while you interact all the way there. For players who like efficient answers backed by a growing bin.
pitch_es: Tu cementerio es un descuento, no un vertedero. Tolarian Terror y Haughty Djinn se vuelven más baratos y más grandes con cada hechizo que aterriza en él, mientras tú interactúas por el camino. Para quienes gustan de respuestas eficientes respaldadas por un cementerio creciente.
rationale_es: Las recompensas cuentan instantáneos/conjuros o criaturas en el cementerio mientras habilitadores de molienda auténticos lo llenan.

core_cards: Serra Redeemer;Quirion Beastcaller;Zar Ojanen, Scion of Efrava;Radha, Coalition Warlord;Strength of the Coalition;Juniper Order Rootweaver;Shalai's Acolyte;King Darien XLVIII;Briar Hydra;A-Briar Hydra;Evolved Sleeper;Take Up the Shield
rationale: Defiler of Vigor mass-pumps every green permanent spell; kicked counter creatures and counter tricks stack the rest.
pitch: Permanent counters on a board that only ever grows. Defiler of Vigor pumps every green creature you cast and the kicked payoffs keep stacking more on top. For players who like a steady beatdown that never has to slow down.
pitch_es: Contadores permanentes sobre un tablero que solo crece. Defiler of Vigor pompea cada criatura verde que lanzas y las recompensas kickeadas siguen apilando más encima. Para quienes gustan de un beatdown constante que nunca tiene que frenar.
rationale_es: Defiler of Vigor pompea en masa cada hechizo de permanente verde; las criaturas con contadores kickeadas y los trucos de contadores apilan el resto.

core_cards: The Phasing of Zhalfir;Silver Scrutiny;Academy Loremaster;Anointed Peacekeeper;Karn's Sylex;Extinguish the Light;Prayer of Binding;Sheoldred, the Apocalypse;Drag to the Bottom;Temporal Firestorm;Protect the Negotiators;Stenn, Paranoid Partisan
rationale: Real sweepers, taxing pieces, instant-speed draw and clean finishers make classic draft control fully buildable.
pitch: Answer everything, then win with a single card. Temporary Lockdown and Drag to the Bottom reset the board before Sheoldred or another bomb quietly takes it over. For players who like saying no and winning late.
pitch_es: Responde a todo y luego gana con una sola carta. Temporary Lockdown y Drag to the Bottom reinician el tablero antes de que Sheoldred u otra bomba se adueñe de él en silencio. Para quienes gustan de decir que no y ganar tarde.
rationale_es: Barredores de verdad, piezas que cobran impuesto, robo a velocidad de instantáneo y finalizadores limpios hacen que el control clásico de draft sea plenamente construible.

keystones: Jhoira, Ageless Innovator;Meria, Scholar of Antiquity;Karn, Living Legacy
core_cards: A-Karn, Living Legacy;Salvaged Manaworker;Automatic Librarian;Meteorite;Inscribed Tablet;Yotia Declares War;Walking Bulwark;Shield-Wall Sentinel;Karn's Sylex;Golden Argosy;Weatherlight Compleated;Timeless Lotus;Astor, Bearer of Blades
rationale: Meria and Jhoira are true engines fed by the cube's cheap nontoken artifact bodies; Karn ramps and pays off density.
pitch: Cheap trinkets that quietly add up to an engine. Jhoira, Ageless Innovator and Meria, Scholar of Antiquity draw cards and make mana off the junk you were casting anyway, while Karn, Living Legacy ramps and rewards the density. For players who enjoy value machines built from small parts.
pitch_es: Cacharros baratos que sin hacer ruido acaban siendo un motor. Jhoira, Ageless Innovator y Meria, Scholar of Antiquity roban cartas y hacen maná con la chatarra que ibas a lanzar de todos modos, mientras Karn, Living Legacy acelera y recompensa la densidad. Para quienes disfrutan de máquinas de valor hechas con piezas pequeñas.
rationale_es: Meria y Jhoira son motores auténticos alimentados por los cuerpos de artefacto no-ficha baratos del cubo; Karn acelera y recompensa la densidad.

core_cards: Knight of Dawn's Light;Elas il-Kor, Sadistic Pilgrim;Stronghold Arena;Samite Herbalist;Phyrexian Missionary;Mesa Cavalier;Hurloon Battle Hymn;Sol'Kanar the Tainted;Archangel of Wrath;Serra Paragon;Mossbeard Ancient
rationale: Shanna converts life gained into cards and Knight of Dawn's Light amplifies the cube's abundant incidental gain.
pitch: Incidental life gain, turned into a real advantage. Shanna, Purifying Blade draws off every point you gain while Sheoldred punishes the opponent for their own draw step. For players who like a steady, resilient grind.
pitch_es: Ganancia de vida incidental convertida en ventaja real. Shanna, Purifying Blade roba con cada punto que ganas mientras Sheoldred castiga al rival por su propio paso de robar. Para quienes gustan de un desgaste constante y resistente.
rationale_es: Shanna convierte la vida ganada en cartas y Knight of Dawn's Light amplifica la abundante ganancia incidental del cubo.

keystones: Soul of Windgrace;Uurg, Spawn of Turg
core_cards: A-Soul of Windgrace;Llanowar Loamspeaker;A-Llanowar Loamspeaker;Sprouting Goblin;Rulik Mons, Warren Chief;Tatyova, Steward of Tides;The Weatherseed Treaty;Joint Exploration;Herd Migration;Serra Paragon
rationale: Soul of Windgrace discards and retrieves lands while Uurg counts them; Serra Paragon replays lands from the graveyard.
pitch: Lands in the graveyard are a resource nobody else is using. Soul of Windgrace and Uurg, Spawn of Turg turn discarded and dead lands back into value and threats. For players who love recursion and grinding out resources.
pitch_es: Las tierras del cementerio son un recurso que nadie más está usando. Soul of Windgrace y Uurg, Spawn of Turg convierten las tierras descartadas y muertas de nuevo en valor y amenazas. Para quienes adoran la recursión y exprimir recursos.
rationale_es: Soul of Windgrace descarta y recupera tierras mientras Uurg las cuenta; Serra Paragon rejuega tierras desde el cementerio.

core_cards: Aether Channeler;Ertai Resurrected;Griffin Protector;Phyrexian Rager;Automatic Librarian;Micromancer;Resolute Reinforcements;Mesa Cavalier;Elas il-Kor, Sadistic Pilgrim;Anointed Peacekeeper
rationale: Golden Argosy mass-blinks its crew every combat, re-buying the cube's dense ETB effects.
pitch: Enter-the-battlefield triggers, collected fresh every combat. Golden Argosy mass-blinks your crew to re-trigger cards like Aether Channeler again and again. For players who enjoy chaining ETB value into relentless advantage.
pitch_es: Disparos de entrada al campo de batalla, recogidos frescos en cada combate. Golden Argosy parpadea en masa a tu tripulación para volver a disparar cartas como Aether Channeler una y otra vez. Para quienes disfrutan encadenando valor de entrada hasta una ventaja implacable.
rationale_es: Golden Argosy parpadea en masa a su tripulación en cada combate, recomprando los densos efectos de entrada del cubo.

core_cards: Llanowar Loamspeaker;A-Llanowar Loamspeaker;Llanowar Stalker;Deathbloom Gardener;Yavimaya Iconoclast;Vineshaper Prodigy;Elvish Hydromancer;Queen Allenal of Ruadach;Radha, Coalition Warlord;Meria, Scholar of Antiquity;Nael, Avizoa Aeronaut;Defiler of Vigor
rationale: Sixteen Elves - the largest tribe - behind a lord that pumps and draws off every Elf spell.
pitch: The biggest tribe in the cube, and it goes wide fast. Leaf-Crowned Visionary pumps and draws off every Elf you cast, backed by mana Elves that get you there a turn early. For players who like snowballing a synergistic creature army.
pitch_es: La tribu más grande del cubo, y va a lo ancho deprisa. Leaf-Crowned Visionary pompea y roba con cada Elfo que lanzas, respaldado por Elfos de maná que te llevan allí un turno antes. Para quienes gustan de hacer bola de nieve con un ejército de criaturas sinérgico.
rationale_es: Dieciséis Elfos — la tribu más grande — detrás de un señor que pompea y roba con cada hechizo de Elfo.

core_cards: Goblin Picker;Splatter Goblin;Sprouting Goblin;A-Sprouting Goblin;Rulik Mons, Warren Chief;A-Rulik Mons, Warren Chief;Defiler of Instinct;Phoenix Chick
rationale: Hordemaster is lord and death payoff in one; Squee recurs himself; Defiler of Instinct pays off red-permanent density.
pitch: Fast red creatures that are perfectly happy to die. Rundvelt Hordemaster is a lord and a death payoff at the same time, and Squee simply keeps coming back for more. For players who want disposable attackers that still generate value.
pitch_es: Criaturas rojas rápidas a las que no les importa morir. Rundvelt Hordemaster es señor y recompensa por muerte a la vez, y Squee sencillamente sigue volviendo a por más. Para quienes quieren atacantes prescindibles que aun así generan valor.
rationale_es: Hordemaster es señor y recompensa por muerte en uno; Squee se recupera a sí mismo; Defiler of Instinct recompensa la densidad de permanentes rojos.

core_cards: Plaza of Heroes;Relic of Legends;Hero's Heirloom;Combat Research;Timeless Lotus
rationale: 48 legendary creatures give Jodah and Ratadrabik constant material, with legend-only mana and equipment as support.
pitch: A wall of legendary creatures that turns into an engine. Jodah, the Unifier and Ratadrabik of Urborg convert your all-stars into extra bodies and extra cards. For players who like fielding a five-colour legendary lineup.
pitch_es: Un muro de criaturas legendarias que se convierte en un motor. Jodah, the Unifier y Ratadrabik of Urborg convierten a tus estrellas en cuerpos extra y cartas extra. Para quienes gustan de alinear una plantilla legendaria pentacolor.
rationale_es: 48 criaturas legendarias dan material constante a Jodah y Ratadrabik, con maná y equipo exclusivos de legendarias como apoyo.

core_cards: Coral Colony;Blight Pile;Walking Bulwark;Academy Wall;Shield-Wall Sentinel;Clockwork Drawbridge;Gibbering Barricade;Floriferous Vinewall
rationale: Three payoffs literally count creatures with defender; Walking Bulwark turns the walls into attackers. No rare needed.
pitch: Walls that stop being walls at exactly the wrong moment. Wingmantle Chaplain rewards a board full of defenders and Walking Bulwark lets the fortress get up and attack. For players who enjoy an unconventional plan with a sting in it.
pitch_es: Muros que dejan de ser muros exactamente en el peor momento. Wingmantle Chaplain recompensa un tablero lleno de defensores y Walking Bulwark hace que la fortaleza se levante y ataque. Para quienes disfrutan de un plan poco convencional con aguijón.
rationale_es: Tres recompensas cuentan literalmente criaturas con defensor; Walking Bulwark convierte los muros en atacantes. No hace falta ninguna rara.

core_cards: Sheoldred's Restoration;Balduvian Atrocity;Bortuk Bonerattle;Eerie Soultender;Monstrous War-Leech;Urborg Repossession;Phyrexian Missionary;Urborg Lhurgoyf;Writhing Necromass;Archangel of Wrath;Silverback Elder
rationale: Four true reanimation effects plus mill to stock targets; Archangel of Wrath and Silverback Elder are premium hits.
pitch: The best card in your deck never needs to be cast. The Cruelty of Gix and friends haul premium hits like Archangel of Wrath straight out of the graveyard. For players who love loading the yard and slamming bombs early.
pitch_es: La mejor carta de tu mazo no necesita lanzarse nunca. The Cruelty of Gix y compañía sacan golpes de primera como Archangel of Wrath directamente del cementerio. Para quienes adoran llenar el cementerio y plantar bombas pronto.
rationale_es: Cuatro efectos de reanimación auténticos más molienda para abastecer objetivos; Archangel of Wrath y Silverback Elder son golpes de primera.

keystones: Astor, Bearer of Blades;Danitha, Benalia's Hope
core_cards: Vanquisher's Axe;Hero's Heirloom;Golden Argosy;Weatherlight Compleated;Yotia Declares War
rationale: Astor tutors and discounts the whole package; support is real but shallow, so it is a build-around.
pitch: One creature, properly armed, on a very short clock. Astor, Bearer of Blades tutors up your Equipment and Vehicles and discounts them on the way in. For players who like a lean, weaponised aggro plan.
pitch_es: Una criatura, bien armada, con un reloj muy corto. Astor, Bearer of Blades busca tus Equipos y Vehículos y los abarata de camino. Para quienes gustan de un plan agro esbelto y armado.
rationale_es: Astor busca y abarata todo el paquete; el apoyo es real pero poco profundo, así que es una construcción alrededor de una carta.

core_cards: Volshe Tideturner;Voda Sea Scavenger;Vohar, Vodalian Desecrator;Vodalian Mindsinger;Tatyova, Steward of Tides;A-Tatyova, Steward of Tides;Defiler of Dreams
rationale: Seven Merfolk behind a single lord; Defiler of Dreams turns blue-permanent density into a draw engine.
pitch: Evasive bodies that pay you for going wide. Vodalian Hexcatcher is a lord and a taxing effect at once, and Defiler of Dreams turns your blue permanents into card draw. For players who like slippery, synergistic beatdown.
pitch_es: Cuerpos evasivos que te pagan por ir a lo ancho. Vodalian Hexcatcher es señor y efecto de impuesto a la vez, y Defiler of Dreams convierte tus permanentes azules en robo. Para quienes gustan del beatdown escurridizo y sinérgico.
rationale_es: Siete Tritones detrás de un único señor; Defiler of Dreams convierte la densidad de permanentes azules en un motor de robo.

core_cards: Elas il-Kor, Sadistic Pilgrim;Anointed Peacekeeper;Phyrexian Missionary;Samite Herbalist;Benalish Faithbonder;Wingmantle Chaplain;Eerie Soultender;Evolved Sleeper
rationale: Eight Clerics behind a lord whose sac ability tutors black creatures; Evolved Sleeper becomes a Cleric on demand.
pitch: A tribe that grinds rather than races. Shadow-Rite Priest sacrifices Clerics to tutor up whichever black creature the game needs, backed by steady drain and lifegain. For players who enjoy a tribal aristocrats hybrid.
pitch_es: Una tribu que desgasta en lugar de correr. Shadow-Rite Priest sacrifica Clérigos para buscar la criatura negra que la partida necesite, respaldada por drenaje y ganancia de vida constantes. Para quienes disfrutan de un híbrido tribal de aristócratas.
rationale_es: Ocho Clérigos detrás de un señor cuya habilidad de sacrificio busca criaturas negras; Evolved Sleeper se convierte en Clérigo a demanda.

core_cards: Rith, Liberated Primeval;Ragefire Hellkite;Dragon Whelp;Shivan Devastator;The Elder Dragon War
rationale: Rivaz makes dragon mana and recasts Dragons from the graveyard; Shivan Devastator qualifies by its Dragon Hydra type line.
pitch: Flying fatties that refuse to stay in the graveyard. Rivaz of the Claw makes Dragon mana and recasts Dragons straight out of the yard, so the pressure never really stops. For players who want a big, splashy top end.
pitch_es: Gordos voladores que se niegan a quedarse en el cementerio. Rivaz of the Claw crea maná de Dragón y relanza Dragones directamente desde el cementerio, así que la presión nunca para de verdad. Para quienes quieren una gama alta grande y llamativa.
rationale_es: Rivaz crea maná de dragón y relanza Dragones desde el cementerio; Shivan Devastator califica por su línea de tipo Dragón Hidra.

core_cards: Liliana of the Veil;Goblin Picker;Thrill of Possibility;Battlewing Mystic;The Elder Dragon War;Aggressive Sabotage;Vohar, Vodalian Desecrator;Guardian of New Benalia;Rona, Sheoldred's Faithful;Phyrexian Espionage
rationale: The Raven Man triggers off any player discarding, so symmetric and self-discard effects all make Birds.
pitch: Make everyone throw their hand away, then profit from it. The Raven Man makes a Bird whenever anybody discards, so symmetric wheels and targeted hand attack both pay you. For players who like disruptive, resource-denial strategies.
pitch_es: Haz que todo el mundo tire su mano y luego saca provecho. The Raven Man crea un Pájaro cada vez que cualquiera descarta, así que tanto las ruedas simétricas como el ataque dirigido a la mano te pagan. Para quienes gustan de estrategias disruptivas de negación de recursos.
rationale_es: The Raven Man se dispara con que cualquier jugador descarte, así que los efectos simétricos y de autodescarte crean todos Pájaros.

core_cards: Leyline Binding;Prayer of Binding;Stronghold Arena;Vesuvan Duplimancy;The Phasing of Zhalfir;The Cruelty of Gix;Love Song of Night and Day;Temporary Lockdown;Urza Assembles the Titans;The World Spell
rationale: Zur animates the cube's ten Sagas and removal enchantments into deathtouch-lifelink-hexproof threats sized by mana value.
pitch: Your removal and your Sagas get up and attack. Zur, Eternal Schemer animates every enchantment you control into a deathtouch-lifelink threat. For players who love a controlling deck with a sneaky enchantment kill.
pitch_es: Tu eliminación y tus Sagas se levantan y atacan. Zur, Eternal Schemer anima cada encantamiento que controlas y lo convierte en una amenaza con toque mortal y vínculo vital. Para quienes adoran un mazo de control con una victoria sigilosa por encantamientos.
rationale_es: Zur anima las diez Sagas y los encantamientos de eliminación del cubo convirtiéndolos en amenazas con toque mortal, vínculo vital y antimaleficio dimensionadas por valor de maná.

core_cards: Combat Research;Hammerhand;Take Up the Shield;Colossal Growth;Strength of the Coalition;Gaea's Might;Twinferno
rationale: Both keystones copy spells that target a single creature you control, turning 14 combat tricks into two-for-ones.
pitch: Every trick you cast happens twice. Ivy, Gleeful Spellthief and Vesuvan Duplimancy copy your single-target spells for two-for-one blowouts. For players who like protecting one threat while piling value on top of it.
pitch_es: Cada truco que lanzas ocurre dos veces. Ivy, Gleeful Spellthief y Vesuvan Duplimancy copian tus hechizos de objetivo único para dos por uno demoledores. Para quienes gustan de proteger una amenaza mientras apilan valor encima.
rationale_es: Ambas piezas clave copian hechizos que apuntan a una sola criatura que controlas, convirtiendo 14 trucos de combate en dos por uno.

core_cards: Liliana of the Veil;Jaya, Fiery Negotiator;Karn, Living Legacy;A-Karn, Living Legacy;Ajani, Sleeper Agent;Plaza of Heroes
rationale: The Saga digs for, deploys, and double-activates planeswalkers; five walkers plus Plaza of Heroes support it.
pitch: Planeswalkers, protected and then activated twice. Urza Assembles the Titans digs for your walkers and doubles their activations while Plaza of Heroes holds the mana together. For players who love grinding advantage a loyalty point at a time.
pitch_es: Planeswalkers, protegidos y luego activados dos veces. Urza Assembles the Titans cava a por tus caminantes y duplica sus activaciones mientras Plaza of Heroes mantiene unido el maná. Para quienes adoran acumular ventaja punto de lealtad a punto de lealtad.
rationale_es: La Saga cava, despliega y activa dos veces a los planeswalkers; cinco caminantes más Plaza of Heroes lo apoyan.

core_cards: A-Radha, Coalition Warlord;Coalition Warbrute;Linebreaker Baloth;Barkweave Crusher;Yavimaya Steelcrusher;Balduvian Berserker;Hexbane Tortoise;Viashino Branchrider;Yavimaya Iconoclast;Colossal Growth;Sprouting Goblin;A-Sprouting Goblin;Molten Monstrosity;Tori D'Avenant, Fury Rider;Rulik Mons, Warren Chief;Squee, Dubious Monarch;Flowstone Kavu;Defiler of Instinct
rationale: Enlist turns green's oversized bodies into red's damage; Radha pumps whenever she's tapped - including by her own enlist - and Keldon Flamesage converts enlisted power into free spells.
pitch: Your big green creatures hit even when they stay home. Enlist taps them to lend their power to an attacker, which pumps Radha, Coalition Warlord on the way, and Keldon Flamesage turns all that borrowed power into free spells. Pick this if you want every creature contributing to every attack.
pitch_es: Tus criaturas verdes grandes pegan incluso cuando se quedan en casa. El enlist las gira para prestar su fuerza a un atacante, lo que de camino pompea a Radha, Coalition Warlord, y Keldon Flamesage convierte toda esa fuerza prestada en hechizos gratuitos. Elige esto si quieres que cada criatura contribuya a cada ataque.
rationale_es: El enlist convierte los cuerpos descomunales del verde en daño del rojo; Radha se pompea cada vez que se gira — incluso por su propio enlist — y Keldon Flamesage convierte la fuerza prestada en hechizos gratuitos.
